title: Hash Tables
definition: A hash table is a data structure mapping keys to values using a hashing function.
intuition: Enables near-constant time operations by computing key indices directly.
how_it_works: Keys are passed to a hash function, mapping them to buckets. Collisions are handled via chaining or open addressing.
when_to_use: For fast lookups, counting, caching, or checking membership.
when_not_to_use: When keys need to be ordered or sorted.
complexity: Insert/Search/Delete: O(1) average, O(n) worst case
content: A hash table is a data structure mapping keys to values using a hashing function.
